title: Transformers: Rescue Bots
description: A team of specialized Autobots not quite ready for prime-time battles against the Decepticons is given a vital mission by Optimus Prime. The goal for the Bots is to learn about mankind and how to help others to find out what it really means to be a hero.

episodes.title: S1-E5The Alien Invasion of Griffin Rock
S2-E16In Search of the Griffin's Nest
S3-E13Did You See What I Thaw?
S3-E26I Have Heard the Robots Singing
S4-E13The More Things Stay the Same

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x1
episodes_data.description: The four members of Rescue Force Sigma-17 emerge and are greeted by the Autobot leader Optimus Prime, who assigns them to work with the Burns family on an island. While the four are supposed to respond to every command the humans give them, they get fed up with it and are tempted to leave Earth. Until, an animatronic dinosaur attacks the island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x2
episodes_data.description: While Chase and Chief Burns pursue an out-of-control robo-landscaper through Griffin Rock, Cody Burns reports that the rest of the team might be delayed, as his siblings are having trouble coming to terms with the fact that their rescue vehicles are alien robots. A volcano suddenly threatens the island of Griffin Rock, sending the Rescue Bots and Burns family into action. The group has to put aside their differences and work together in order to save the island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x4
episodes_data.description: Flying lobsters invade a summer festival, and an angry Heatwave refuses to help fight them.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x5
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots are put in danger when a resident of Griffin Rock threatens to expose the secret of an "alien invasion.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x6
episodes_data.description: Boulder decides that the team needs an animal mascot but maybe a zoo isn't the best place to find one.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x7
episodes_data.description: Cody accidentally unleashes a swarm of futuristic nanites while he's trying to super-charge his go-kart to help in the team's rescue missions.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x8
episodes_data.description: The Bots are enlisted to watch after Doc Greene's Robo-Baby.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x9
episodes_data.description: Cody, his family and the Rescue Bots have to stop a snow storm in July when a weather machine goes haywire.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x10
episodes_data.description: A shark targeting high-tech ocean equipment is spotted off the Griffin Rock shore.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x12
episodes_data.description: A scientist tries to replace the team with a new invention, leaving everyone out of the action.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x13
episodes_data.description: Cody looks for proof that the new scientist's invention is really a villainous plan.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x14
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots are accidentally shrunk and the Burns family must work without their partners.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x15
episodes_data.description: Cody finds a clue to an old mystery and makes a startling underwater discovery.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x16
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots disobey the Chief's orders and find themselves in a life-threatening situation.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x17
episodes_data.description: A storm strands Cody on a deserted island where they find a pirate ship that holds the key to a mystery.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x18
episodes_data.description: Bumblebee pays the Rescue Bots a visit just in time to help investigate a mysterious meteor.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x19
episodes_data.description: The Bots and Burns must stop a giant glob of space slime before it consumes the town.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x20
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Rescue Bots try to solve the vanishing mystery when the residents of Griffin Rock start disappearing.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x21
episodes_data.description: Ghosts haunt and terrorize the residents of Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x22
episodes_data.description: The kids are covertly planning a surprise birthday party for their father. Chief Burns tells them he is heading to the docks, but actually takes a trip to the bakery for a cake, as a present for his family, thinking that they forgot his birthday. Chase discovers this to be a lie and is confounded by this. While setting up the party back home, the kids and the other Rescue Bots realize that Chase and Chief Burns are missing, and search the entire town. Eventually they discover the two trapped inside an underground mine, and save them from the flooding water and falling rocks.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x23
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots lead the rescue efforts when a series of earthquakes strike the island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x24
episodes_data.description: Doc Greene invents a repulsor badge that allows the wearer to be occluded from projectiles. Cody uses it to participate more on the front lines, in missions with the rest of his family, against Chief Burns concern of his safety. His superhero status, however, is halted when his repulsor badge is overloaded and projects a nonstop field, enclosing him inside. Boulder uses neutralizing gloves, also invented by Doc Greene, to bypass the repulsive field and successfully remove the badge from Cody, shortly before it detonates.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x25
episodes_data.description: When Doc Greene's experiment with a time machine goes awry, the Bots end up being captured by an old nemesis.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 1x26
episodes_data.description: When the Bots return home, they find that Doctor Morocco is in command of Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x1
episodes_data.description: With the Rescue Bots' secret now known to Frankie and Doc, Cody has to deal with a new family dynamic as well as an unpredictable teleportation device.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x2
episodes_data.description: Frankie's contest entry not only threatens her friendship with Cody and the Bots, but the safety of the entire island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x3
episodes_data.description: Experimental technology turns Cody into a grown-up, affecting his standing in the family and on the rescue team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x4
episodes_data.description: A mysterious iceberg off the coast of Griffin Rock brings both danger and the interest of an old nemesis.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x5
episodes_data.description: The virtual becomes real. Heatwave realizes Blades's potential as a true hero.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x6
episodes_data.description: The Bots and the Burnses are in mind-controlled stupors. Cody scrambles to snap them out of it before he's sucked in.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x7
episodes_data.description: The Team is forced to participate in a reality show that captures extreme danger on camera.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x8
episodes_data.description: Kade's nightmares come to life and threaten Griffin Rock and Cody and the Rescue Bots must help.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x9
episodes_data.description: While trying to hunt it down, Cody and the Bots discover the legendary Maine Ridge Monster is closer than they thought.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x10
episodes_data.description: Cody's Uncle Woodrow pays a visit, resulting in the entire Rescue Team (along with Optimus Prime) going on an unexpected mission below the surface of the earth.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x11
episodes_data.description: Stuck underground and separated, the Rescue Bots and the Burnses, teamed with Optimus Prime, must regroup and work together to escape a primeval world of strange creatures.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x12
episodes_data.description: When an experimental Space Elevator strands Doc and Graham in orbit, the Rescue Bots dust off their old ship and attempt a risky rescue.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x13
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Bots are led on an adventure to an island filled with dangerous technology.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x14
episodes_data.description: The new computer designed to keep Griffin Rock safe becomes dangerous.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x15
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Team goes on a nature hike; escaped snakes reek havoc in Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x16
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Rescue Bots go on a quest to find the mythical Griffin's nest.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x17
episodes_data.description: Chase goes rogue on an undercover mission as the Bots and Burns family do their best to save the island without using any modern technology.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x18
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Bots find a stray dog who ends up joining the rescue team, but Priscilla Pynch has other plans for the pet.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x19
episodes_data.description: Doctor Morocco learns a devastating secret that threatens the Rescue Bots' mission, but Optimus Prime guides Heatwave to acquire a surprising new ability.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x20
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Team has to take action when rogue technology goes underground.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x21
episodes_data.description: When Bumblebee partners up with Dani on a mission, Blades feels left out.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x22
episodes_data.description: A mysterious superhero keeps a close eye on Griffin Rock while the Rescue Team rebuilds a train tunnel.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x23
episodes_data.description: A plan is hatched by Griffin Rock's most evil villains to destroy the island and kidnap the Bots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 2x24
episodes_data.description: The Bots are made to believe the Burnses are their enemies after they're wiped of their memories.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x1
episodes_data.description: After discovering an island of dinosaurs, Optimus must embrace his primal side.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x2
episodes_data.description: Optimus Prime's new Dinosaur Mode becomes the target of a big game hunter.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x3
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Rescue Bots show Kade a valuable lesson in teamwork after Doc's imaging chamber creates exact replicas of him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x4
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots and the Burns family get on a ghost ship that emerges once every ten years.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x5
episodes_data.description: Recalling a mission left unaccomplished prior to their arrival on Earth, Chase and Boulder return to space to complete the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x6
episodes_data.description: When Doc creates a giant dome to shield Griffin Rock from a hurricane, he inadvertently gives the Vigilant Computer a second chance to "protect" the island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x7
episodes_data.description: Doctor Morocco proves that even small pests can pose dangerous threats to Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x8
episodes_data.description: A space nebula causes the Rescue Bots and Burns family to switch personalities.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x9
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots take on new responsibilities during a terrible snowstorm.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x10
episodes_data.description: Kade accidentally ingests microscopic cleaning robots and the Rescue Bots must go on an inner space voyage to save him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x11
episodes_data.description: Colonel Quarry seeks additional robotic dinosaurs from Doc, so Heatwave, Chase, and Blades transform into DinoBots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x12
episodes_data.description: While Charlie Burns is away at a Police Conference, Woodrow Burns returns to watch over the rest of the Burns Family. Woodrow then takes command of the Rescue Bots team without the entire Burns Family knowing about it where they have trouble with his cooking that involves things he made in the rainforest. After Woodrow's successful rescue strategy save Mayor Luskey's boat, Mayor Luskey makes Woodrow the acting police chief where he eventually helps the Rescue Bots when some beacons Mayor Luskey was using to improve the Dolphin Wonder Festival gets some dolphins stuck in Griffin Rock's wetlands.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x13
episodes_data.description: The Bots discover a caveman preserved in ice and attempt to help him adjust to modern life.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x14
episodes_data.description: Monsters from Kade's favorite movie materialize; it's up to the Dino Bots to corral the Kaiju.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x15
episodes_data.description: On the first day of Spring, the Burns Family and the Rescue Bots stop a mudslide. Mayor Luskey establishes Bot Appreciation Day where anyone who attends will each get a miniature action figure made by Doc Greene's 3-D printer. When Myles and Evan reprogram the action figures to steal for them, the Rescue Bots must deal with the action figures while the Burns Family is stuck at sea due to the kelp and the poisonous jellyfish.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x16
episodes_data.description: A renovated clock tower causes Cody to relive the same morning over and over.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Team is suspended when evidence arises that the Burnses are pirate descendants.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x18
episodes_data.description: An old friend of Optimus arrives to train the Bots in ocean rescues.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x19
episodes_data.description: Dr. Morocco's best friend, famous writer Jules Verne, travels through time to find him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x20
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Bots find they have new recruits to train, but these newbies are hiding a dark secret.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x21
episodes_data.description: Cody and the Rescue Bots must teach Blurr and Salvage everything they need to know.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x22
episodes_data.description: A solar flare knocks out power in Griffin Rock; Blurr deserts the Rescue Bots and steals the ship.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x23
episodes_data.description: Cyber-Dog Servo puts the Rescue Bots' undercover status in jeopardy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x24
episodes_data.description: The Bots go to extremes to protect endangered woodpeckers discovered by Boulder.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x25
episodes_data.description: An injured Chase uncovers many mysteries while Doc's magician sister visits Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x26
episodes_data.description: Priscilla Pynch's theft of Doc's latest invention causes the entire populace of Griffin Rock to erupt into an endless musical.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 3x27
episodes_data.description: The Island of Griffin Rock vanishes from the ocean.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x1
episodes_data.description: Three years after we last saw our heroes, an alien attack forces the Rescue Bots to make a decision as to whether to reveal their true natures to the citizens of Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x2
episodes_data.description: The citizens of Griffin Rock are deciding whether or not to let the Bots stay in their midst when a GroundBridge accident splits the team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x3
episodes_data.description: As Frankie struggles to adjust to life with her baby sister, the Bots are surprised by a new arrival of their own.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x4
episodes_data.description: When Heatwave invites her to take a turn at leadership, Quickshadow upsets the Rescue Team's dynamic.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x5
episodes_data.description: When Chief is convinced by Cody to try a virtual reality video game, an old nemesis is uncovered; the team must stop the villain from destroying the real Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x6
episodes_data.description: The Bots deal with a group of investors who want to build a vacation resort in Griffin Rock, while Cody deals with feeling invisible around everyone.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x7
episodes_data.description: As Griffin Rock celebrates its version of Halloween, Evan and Myles car-jack Quickshadow and discover the Bots' secret.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x8
episodes_data.description: When the Rescue Bots are captured by a new villain, the Burns family finds an unexpected ally in a former enemy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x9
episodes_data.description: The town of Griffin Rock gets more than it bargained for when Chase is elected as the new mayor.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x10
episodes_data.description: During a Cybertronian holiday, the Rescue Bots take on their biggest challenge yet - a super-sized, overtired baby.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x11
episodes_data.description: When Griffin Rock's communication tower needs replacing, the Bots and Burnses take on part-time jobs to raise the money.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x12
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Team struggles with last minute preparations as they finally open the mainland Training Center.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x13
episodes_data.description: The Bots' Mainland Training Center is in danger of being discovered and, to make matters worse, the Rescue Team is trapped inside with a glitching hologram.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x14
episodes_data.description: Blurr is torn between his desire to be a winning racecar and a working Rescue Bot; Dani helps Blurr find balance.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x15
episodes_data.description: Chief helps Woodrow rescue gorillas from a volcanic eruption; his sons learn they are heirs to the throne of Griffin Rock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x16
episodes_data.description: While at Griffin Rock's Pizza Pi Festival, Doc's new super-yeast causes chaos and the Bots have to find an unconventional solution to the rising problem.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x17
episodes_data.description: When Bumblebee makes an unexpected appearance at the Bots' Training Center, he brings along more than a few surprises for the team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x18
episodes_data.description: When Blades is unable to participate in a Lad Pioneer leveling up ceremony on the mainland due to his Bot form, Graham and Cody help disguise him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x19
episodes_data.description: The Rescue Team is drawn into the woods to solve the mystery of what's making the Griffin Spruces fall.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x20
episodes_data.description: A mysterious criminal and unexpected visitor challenge Blurr's future as a Rescue Bot.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x21
episodes_data.description: Energon and technology have fallen into treacherous hands and it is up to the Burns family and their Bots to steal them back.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x22
episodes_data.description: Kade's idol, an arrogant movie star, comes to Griffin Rock in preparation for a role, causing trouble for the Rescue Team while they try to solve a series of mysterious break-ins.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x23
episodes_data.description: When Dani's out-of-this-world test flight doesn't go according to plan, the Rescue Team strives to ensure she makes it back home.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x24
episodes_data.description: Cody rides along with each of the Bots to decide what kind of rescue worker he wants to be.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x25
episodes_data.description: When Optimus Prime splits the Rescue Bots into different teams for new assignments, the evil genius Doctor Morocco returns to wreak havoc.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots 4x26
episodes_data.description: The computer-generated Doctor Morocco hatches a bold new plot to defeat the Rescue Bots by becoming one of them.
